Q8033.reason: Sudden monocular vision loss with optic disk pallor and normal eye movements indicates optic neuritis from optic nerve demyelination.

Q8034.reason: Restlessness, tachycardia and diminished breath sounds after the air leak stopped suggest the chest tube is blocked or displaced and the pneumothorax has recurred, so the tube needs repositioning (or replacing).
